name: Mihinpurwa–Katarniaghat National Highway
significance: NH 730H is a branch of NH 730. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one leaves NH 730 at Kundwa, near Mihinpurwa, and runs north-west past Nishangara and Bichia to Katarniaghat, in the Katarniaghat Wildlife Sanctuary close to the Nepal border.
